judgment.rationale: Both are same-grain Knowledge Objectives in P2 (rank 1) under Unit 6 'Standard unit of capacity measurements "litre"'. Same-rank direction is supported by pair-specific substance rather than shared parentage alone: qualitative/quantitative comparison of container capacities establishes capacity as a comparable measured quantity, which is the conceptual basis for then operating arithmetically (adding and subtracting) on capacity measurements in litres. The shared Key Unit Competence explicitly sequences 'measure, compare, add, and subtract capacity measurements', corroborating comparison as the supporting competence and combination/extension in the additive objective (LC tags: compare/containers vs addition/subtraction).
